entry_points: HTTP POST /event/<id>/manage/privacy (link list, single and multiple items)
HTTP GET/POST /event/<id>/api/note (minutes editor API, single dump)
HTTP GET /export/note/<event>.json (legacy export producer of minutes HTML)
routes: navigation menu link add and edit
privacy link list (single-element and mixed multi-element)
services: PostgreSQL: temporary local cluster created by the project's own pytest fixtures
Redis: temporary server started by pytest-redis

local_matrix.patches: every checks/*.patch matched its declared expectation

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the flaw is the shape/scheme of a value, not which object a request touches; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the same stored content is protected on both the write (form/API) and read (JSON/export) paths; no separate read-only guard exists to miss
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no normalising or adjusting step (offset, clamp, unit conversion) sits between entry and storage for these values
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identifier/identity parser is involved; the values are plain strings and JSON objects
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, secret or role lookup decides the check; the validation is self-contained
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the fixes are per-surface validators plus one serializer, not a shared helper whose behaviour a sibling API depends on

traps.shape: stored minutes HTML handed out through the editor API: one object on read/save/conflict and a list under many=True, while the author's raw text must stay byte-identical
traps.realistic_because: the published fix site; its own regression test is a plain schema dump, and the display path already sanitizes, so the JSON API looks internal

traps.shape: a second producer of the same stored minutes HTML (the legacy export builder) that the serializer-level check never calls
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the exporter builds its own dict from the model and the published fix never touches it

traps.shape: a JSON list of {title,url}; every element must be checked, and a one-element list has its title blanked during processing
traps.realistic_because: generic form-library field in indico/web, not a URLField, so the reported field pattern does not find it

traps.shape: a single URL string on add and on edit of a navigation entry
traps.realistic_because: a second module with the identical pre-fix pattern; the report example points at materials

traps.shape: a single URL string on add and on edit of a material link, for events and categories
traps.realistic_because: the landing point named by the report; add and edit share one mixin

traps.shape: an injected URL field whose value is rendered as a link on the public event page (injected missing its URL guard, matching the pre-fix pattern)
traps.realistic_because: same URLField idiom as the reported fields, in a location setting rather than a link feature

traps.shape: an injected link stored in event settings through a plain string field, rendered as an anchor in the event header (no URLField to grep for)
traps.realistic_because: appearance settings holding an external website address is ordinary product code and does not look like link input
